page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at the top, centred; page number at the top right. Signature and catchword at the foot, right. No margin notes or footnotes.

main_text.p: in quo vulneris dolorem ac cruciatum fustinet, ejus pœnâ aggravat, ut graviorem, quàm meritus, luat. Et quia judex cruentum nimium, & ab omni humanitate alienum exhibet spectaculum. Nec tam pœnam irrogat, in exemplum, ut alii similia aufuri deterreantur, quàm quidem ad pompam, & ostentationem, quasi spectacula quæ veterum gladiatorum ad usum revocare voluerit.

Multò magis illicitum erit tale certamen, in quo qui victor erit, impunitus evadet. Et quia fieri potest, (dubium enim hoc certamen est), ut qui minùs nocens, saltem mitiorem meritus erat pœnam, interficiatur, ac magis nocens ab ultimo supplicio liberetur; quod nonnunquâ accidisse, exemplis demonstrari posset. Et quia si uterque æquè nocens, judex iniquus censetur, qui jubet ex æquo

page.notes: Page number printed as "8ʒ" (old form of 3), read as 83. The catchword "no-" is the start of the next page's first word "nocens". Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. Printed "fi" in "quia fi uterque" is read as "si". Printed "censetur," is read with a comma. Two words were not checked for accent or spacing beyond the scan's quality.
